name: reviewer_feedback_consumption
summary: Prior reviewer feedback moved v0.8 toward clearer product positioning, stronger local reproducibility, more demo evidence, and stricter risk boundaries; v0.9 carries that evidence forward with source-boundary walkthrough receipt coverage.
safety_notice: Educational research review only. This tool does not provide personalized investment, legal, accounting, tax, buy, sell, or hold advice.

feedback_threads.title: Product Clarity
feedback_consumed: v0.1 flagged synthetic data as the main trust gap and asked for a public static fixture and clearer promotion path.
v0.2 closed the public static fixture gap and shifted remaining clarity work toward preview and distribution evidence.
v0.7 added adoption positioning through the spreadsheet comparison.
v0.8 aligns README, usage docs, release notes, reviewer evidence, publication checklist, templates, examples index, doctor output, and generated maturity evidence around the 0.8.0 release line.

feedback_threads.title: Reproducibility
feedback_consumed: v0.3 and v0.4 treated deterministic previews, manifests, and reviewer evidence as release-quality requirements.
v0.6 expanded reproducibility evidence to include playbooks, playbook output examples, handoff packet examples, release assets, and maturity evidence.
v0.8 records exact verification commands and fresh clone validation.

feedback_threads.title: Demo Evidence

v0_8_result.remaining_constraint: Hosted demo deployment is a release-owner decision, not a package requirement.

feedback_consumed: v0.1 and v0.2 requested screenshot, GIF, or Pages-style preview evidence.
v0.3 closed preview evidence with a PNG-free SVG preview and local static dashboard guidance.
v0.4 improved evidence quality with schema, compare artifacts, package and reviewer evidence docs, and generated manifests.
v0.6 added recurring workflow evidence through research playbooks and generated playbook examples.
v0.8 keeps demo evidence inspectable through gallery, public case study, case study map, and reviewer evidence.

feedback_threads.title: Risk Boundaries

v0_8_result.remaining_constraint: Release-owner approval is required before public promotion, hosted deployment, package publishing, or any live-source integration.

feedback_consumed: v0.1 and v0.2 risk reviewers accepted the boundary but warned against implying source data is live, current, or verified.
v0.4 and later reviews reinforced that public examples, dashboards, and promotion copy must preserve stale/static badges and source-boundary labels.
v0.7 clarified when spreadsheets, generic notes, or other tools are better fits.
v0.8 keeps public copy and handoff docs inside the educational, non-advice, source-attributed, local-only boundary.

owner_gates: package publish dry run if publishing
